goal: Verify that a user can create a new account as the Site Host, navigate to the June 2026 calendar view, and successfully advance the calendar to the next year (2027).
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged in, locate the calendar widget and click the button labeled 'June 2026' to open the monthly view.
In the calendar view, click the right-pointing arrow button (labeled 'Next year') located in the top-right corner of the calendar header to advance the year.
Confirm that the calendar view updates to display the year '2027'.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the signup page to the main dashboard after clicking 'Sign up'.
The calendar view initially displays 'June 2026' with the correct dates for that month.
After clicking the navigation button, the calendar header updates to show '2027'.
The calendar grid displays the correct months and dates for the year 2027.
No error messages or loading failures appear during the account creation or calendar navigation steps.
